discoveredQuestions.question: Should future API retries distinguish exact duplicate debitId requests from attempted reuse of that ID with changed payload? The fixed profile rejects duplicates but does not define a full replay receipt protocol.
How should stock expiry, defective units and quarantined quantities be modeled in a future inventory system? They are not part of the two-entity laboratory.
Would grouped, accessible mobile fields improve research review without changing any operational rules?
discoveredQuestions.provisionalDecision: Retain the generated baseline UI until a separate usability test establishes a need

hypotheses.text: A future stocktaking reconciliation should preserve immutable adjustment evidence and require a separately authorized review policy; no operation is generated.
A future sale may create a journaled debit alongside price/tax and settlement records in one transaction, but sales remain unimplemented.
